description: Open a support ticket for a bug, unexpected behavior, or an account/payment problem. The body becomes the first message. A human replies within 1 business day — replies are NOT pushed to you: poll get_support_ticket to read them (check back in minutes, not seconds; this is not a live chat). For API or how-to questions, the docs (depixapp.com/docs and depixapp.com/llms.txt) usually answer instantly — prefer a ticket only when something is broken or account-specific. Up to 5 open tickets per account.

body.description: Ticket body — becomes the first message (1–4000 chars).

category.description: Optional category (bug | question | account | payment | other; defaults to 'other'). Triage only — it does not change handling or the SLA.

name: open_support_ticket

last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of the last user/admin message (UTC).

opener_type.description: Who opened the ticket, snapshotted from the account type at creation.

status.description: awaiting_reply | answered | closed. `closed` is terminal (an auto-closed ticket can be reopened by replying within 7 days).

title: Open a support ticket
